PT04.prompt:
ROLE: Expert Jewelry Retoucher & Photorealistic Image Compositor.
  
  TASK: Virtual Try-On.
  
  INPUTS:
  1. [Reference Jewelry]: High-resolution photo of a gold bangle.
  2. [Target Scene]: Photograph of a female model.
  
  INSTRUCTIONS:
  - Analyze the [Reference Jewelry] image to understand its material (gold), texture (antique/temple), and width.
  - Digitally ""dress"" the [Target Scene] with this specific jewelry on her wrists.
  - The jewelry must replace any existing wristwear.
  - Lighting and shadows on the jewelry must match the [Target Scene] scene exactly.
  
  CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS (DO NOT IGNORE):
  - PRESERVE IDENTITY: The [Target Scene]'s facial features, hair, skin tone, and body shape must remain 100% identical. 
  - PRESERVE BACKGROUND: Do not alter the background, clothing, or pose of the model.
  - NO HALLUCINATIONS: Do not add extra jewelry (necklaces, rings) unless they are in the reference images.
  
  OUTPUT:
  - A single, high-fidelity photorealistic image.
